Description: Permanent infrastructure identifier — assigned by data manager; never changes
QC_Rule: No duplicates; no nulls; format must follow pattern; stable across all updates

Description: Parent community identifier — assigned via spatial join (SJ11); verify with field records
QC_Rule: Must resolve to DB01 Community_ID; no nulls

Description: Infrastructure type code
QC_Rule: No nulls; must resolve to LKP_InfrastructureType.csv

Description: Descriptive name or label for this infrastructure item
QC_Rule: No nulls; e.g. 'Owerri-Aba federal highway bridge at Otamiri River'

Description: GPS latitude of infrastructure item in decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds; must be within 10km of parent community

Description: GPS longitude of infrastructure item in decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds

Description: GPS horizontal accuracy in metres
QC_Rule: No nulls; flag >30m; reject >100m

Description: Physical condition at time of observation
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only

Description: Whether item is within flood hazard zone — field assessment
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only; to be updated by GIS analysis (G29)

Description: Whether item is threatened by active erosion — field assessment
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only; to be updated by GIS analysis (G30)

Description: Distance to nearest river in metres — calculated from G05 after GIS phase; do not manually enter
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; populated by GIS script

Description: Damage severity on 0–4 scale consistent with LKP_ErosionSeverity scale (0=none; 4=critical)
QC_Rule: If present must be integer 0–4

Description: Whether this item's services were disrupted at time of observation
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Estimated number of people whose services are affected by damage or disruption
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; NULL if not estimated

Allowed_Values: No repair needed, Planned, In progress, Completed, Unknown, NULL
Description: Status of repair works if applicable
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Whether this infrastructure provides a critical service — from LKP_InfrastructureType.csv Critical_Service field; confirm in field
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only; must be consistent with LKP_InfrastructureType.csv

Description: Date infrastructure item was observed in field
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date; >= 2026-01-01; not future

Description: Reference IDs of site photographs
QC_Rule: If present must have corresponding files in 02_Fieldwork/Photos/

Description: Field observer name or code
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Field notes including description of damage or threat
QC_Rule: Review before publication

Description: Date record entered
QC_Rule: Auto-populated; no nulls

Description: Date record last modified
QC_Rule: Auto-populated on update

Description: Data version
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Processing status
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv
